def diff(prev, cur):
    a = prev.ascii.split('\n'); b = cur.ascii.split('\n')
    out = []
    for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a,b)):
        if x!=y:
            cols = [j for j in range(min(len(x),len(y))) if x[j]!=y[j]]
            if i==63: continue
            out.append((i, cols))
    return out

steps = [(10,52,'cross while LONG'), (21,39,'green L plus -> short'), (10,52,'cross while SHORT'), (21,45,'green R plus -> long')]
for r,c,label in steps:
    prev = current_frame
    res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    d = diff(prev, current_frame)
    print(label, ':', d or 'NO')
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def diff(prev, cur):
    a = prev.ascii.split('\n'); b = cur.ascii.split('\n')
    out = []
    for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a,b)):
        if x!=y:
            cols = [j for j in range(min(len(x),len(y))) if x[j]!=y[j]]
            if i==63: continue
            out.append((i, cols))
    return out

steps = [(10,52,'cross while LONG'), (21,39,'green L plus -> short'), (10,52,'cross while SHORT'), (21,45,'green R plus -> long')]

    prev = current_frame
    res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    d = diff(prev, current_frame)
